title: C: Task Queue
description: Build a task queue system with a pool of workers that process tasks from a shared queue.

steps.title: Task Queue with Workers
steps.description: Define a `Task` struct with a function pointer `void (*run)(void*)` and void* arg. Create a `TaskQueue` that holds up to 100 tasks. Write `void tq_enqueue(TaskQueue *q, Task t)` and `Task tq_dequeue(TaskQueue *q)`. Test by enqueueing 3 tasks and dequeueing/executing them.
hints: enqueue adds at rear, dequeue removes from front.

verification.failureMessage: Execute all 3 tasks from the queue in order
